title: Surreal Cosmic Childhood
description: A surreal scene depicts a giant baby's head with an open mouth and cranial sutures, encircled by a large black snake and a metallic beetle. Below on a grassy hill, three armored children with root-like feet emit golden energy beams and sparks, while a stained-glass window floats in the sky showing faces and abstract patterns against a dramatic, colorful landscape.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a giant bald baby's head floating in a dramatic sky with open mouth and visible cranial sutures, a large black snake forming an infinity shape around it intertwined with a metallic beetle, below on a grassy hill three young boys in futuristic golden and black armor with roots for feet emitting bright golden energy beams and sparks from their hands, floating cartoonish creatures and colorful rings scattered around, a large colorful stained glass window in the sky containing faces and abstract designs with light rays beaming down, vibrant green hills and purple dramatic sky in the background
